name: 5,6-MeO-MiPT
summary: 5,6-MeO-MiPT, also known as 5,6-dimethoxy-N-methyl-N-isopropyltryptamine, is a chemical compound of the tryptamine family. It is the 5,6-dimethoxy derivative of methylisopropyltryptamine (MiPT) and is an analogue of 5-MeO-MiPT. In his 1991 book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), Alexander Shulgin listed the dose as greater than 75 mg orally and the duration as unknown.
summaryZh: 5,6-MeO-MiPT是一種色胺衍生物，化學式為C16H24N2O2，由亞歷山大·舒爾金開發，屬於甲基異丙基色胺的衍生物，可作為致幻劑。

uses.en: It is a little-known research compound described in Shulgin's work.
uses.zh: 它是Shulgin著作中描述的一種鮮為人知的研究用化合物。
uses.zhHans: 它是Shulgin著作中描述的一种鲜为人知的研究用化合物。

fact.en: It has two methoxy groups instead of one, at the 5 and 6 positions. Adding the second one appears to weaken the drug compared with 5-MeO-MiPT.
fact.zh: 它有兩個甲氧基而不是一個，分別位於第5與第6位。與5-MeO-MiPT相比，多出的第二個甲氧基似乎讓藥效變弱。
fact.zhHans: 它有两个甲氧基而不是一个，分别位于第5与第6位。与5-MeO-MiPT相比，多出的第二个甲氧基似乎让药效变弱。
